description.value: The Westside Learning Lab is a community branch of the Okanagan Regional Library, a 30-branch regional system established in 1936 that serves over 399,000 people across south-central British Columbia. Located on the Okanagan Highway on Kelowna's west side, it gives the public free access to ORL's digital collections, e-learning resources, and system-wide programs including Makerspaces and a Library of Things technology-lending service. As a publicly accessible library branch it provides a useful rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the Westside corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific branch page at the OSM URL returns a 404 'page not found', so no branch-level amenity details are available from the website. However, 'Westside Learning Lab' appears in the ORL website's branch navigation selector across multiple pages, confirming the branch is still an active location. OSM provides the address and an internet_access=wlan tag, but per evidence rules the Wi-Fi tag cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation, and no other amenities can be confirmed without the branch page loading.
concerns: The specific OSM URL (https://www.orl.bc.ca/hours-locations/learning-lab) returns a 404 page not found; the branch page may have been removed or relocated on the ORL website, though the branch still appears in the site-wide branch selector.
No phone number is recorded in OSM for this branch.
OSM address (525 Okanagan Highway, V1Z 4C9) could not be confirmed from website content because the specific branch page did not load.
OSM tag internet_access=wlan suggests Wi-Fi but could not be confirmed via website content per evidence rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Westside Learning Lab is a real, publicly accessible ORL branch confirmed active by its presence in the ORL website branch navigation; it is a useful stop for touring cyclists and belongs in the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: The ORL system-wide offers Makerspaces and a Library of Things (technology lending) at select branches; it is unclear from available content whether Westside Learning Lab specifically provides these services.
